scripts.preinstall: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('package-lock.json', { force: true }); require('node:fs').rmSync('yarn.lock', { force: true }); if (!(process.env.npm_config_user_agent || '').startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
